generation.gooo_source:
package joins
namespace joins
entity Integer id "joins://integer"
entity Boolean id "joins://boolean"
entity Text id "joins://text"

activity Left(Integer) -> Integer computes "let a = (1 - input)\nlet b = (3 - a)\nreturn (9 - b)" assembling {
    baseline "let a = input - 1\nlet b = a - 3\nreturn b - 9"
    picked "first" -> "layout_reverse"
    picked "second" -> "layout_reverse"
    picked "third" -> "layout_reverse"
    choice "first" operand_order at "0" intent "첫 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the first operands."
    choice "second" operand_order at "1" intent "두 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the second operands."
    choice "third" operand_order at "2" intent "세 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the third operands."
    case "-8" -> "15"
    case "-1" -> "8"
    case "0" -> "7"
    case "3" -> "4"
    case "4" -> "3"
    case "9" -> "-2"
    attempts "8"
}
activity Right(Integer) -> Integer computes "return input * 2"
activity Add(Integer, Integer) -> Integer computes "return input0 + input1"
activity Difference(Integer, Integer) -> Integer computes "return input0 - input1"
activity Label(Integer, Boolean, Text) -> Text computes `if input1 && input0 > 0 { return input2 + "!" } else { return input2 }`
activity Compare(Text, Text) -> Boolean computes "return input0 == input1"
activity Invert(Boolean) -> Boolean computes "return !input"

bind Left.result -> Add.input0
bind Right.result -> Add.input1
bind Right.result -> Difference.input0
bind Left.result -> Difference.input1
bind Add.result -> Label.input0
bind Compare.result -> Invert.input

composition.gooo_source:
package joins
namespace joins
entity Integer id "joins://integer"
entity Boolean id "joins://boolean"
entity Text id "joins://text"

activity Left(Integer) -> Integer computes "let a = (1 - input)\nlet b = (3 - a)\nreturn (9 - b)" assembling {
    baseline "let a = input - 1\nlet b = a - 3\nreturn b - 9"
    picked "first" -> "layout_reverse"
    picked "second" -> "layout_reverse"
    picked "third" -> "layout_reverse"
    choice "first" operand_order at "0" intent "첫 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the first operands."
    choice "second" operand_order at "1" intent "두 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the second operands."
    choice "third" operand_order at "2" intent "세 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the third operands."
    case "-8" -> "15"
    case "-1" -> "8"
    case "0" -> "7"
    case "3" -> "4"
    case "4" -> "3"
    case "9" -> "-2"
    attempts "8"
}
activity Right(Integer) -> Integer computes "return input * 2"
activity Add(Integer, Integer) -> Integer computes "return input0 + input1"
activity Difference(Integer, Integer) -> Integer computes "return input0 - input1"
activity Label(Integer, Boolean, Text) -> Text computes `if input1 && input0 > 0 { return input2 + "!" } else { return input2 }`
activity Compare(Text, Text) -> Boolean computes "return input0 == input1"
activity Invert(Boolean) -> Boolean computes "return !input"

bind Left.result -> Add.input0
bind Right.result -> Add.input1
bind Right.result -> Difference.input0
bind Left.result -> Difference.input1
bind Add.result -> Label.input0
bind Compare.result -> Invert.input
